asr.full_text: Doge is currently at 0.091, and the real question is are we finally going to see a break out from this range or is the market about to repeat the same cycle again? In the last update we clearly mark the support around 0.090 and once again price respected that perfectly. Buyers stepped in at that level, defended it cleanly, and those pushed up toward the resistance around 0.095. That move alone delivered around 6% which is a solid return for a short range trade. But here's what makes this even more interesting this is not the first time this has happened. Over the past month DOGE has been moving inside this exact range again and again. We've seen multiple reactions from the same support at 0.090 and every time price moves up, it targets the same resistance zones around 0.095 and 0.10. And what happens there? Price gets rejected, especially around 0.096, sellers keep stepping in, pushing price back down towards support. This repeated behavior tells you one thing very clearly, the market is respecting this range, and both buyers and sellers are active at their respective levels. Now coming to the current situation, nothing has changed yet. Price is once again holding above the support at 0.090. As long as this level continues to hold, the direction remains to the upside within the range. This means the same strategy continues to work, buying near support and targeting resistance. But this is where discipline matters. Most traders make the mistake of chasing price in the middle of the range that's where risk is highest and reward is lowest the real edge comes from sticking to the levels and waiting for price to come to you at the same time you need to stay alert the more a range gets, the higher the probability that it eventually breaks. If Doge manages to break above 0.096 and hold above it, that could shift the structure and open the door towards 0.10 and potentially higher levels. On the flip side, if support at 0.090 fails, then the entire range breaks down and the structure turns bearish that would likely lead to a move toward a lower levels as sellers take control right now we are still inside the range support is holding resistance is rejecting and the structure remains unchanged this is a traders market where patience & level-based trading matter more than emotions. So, the real question is – Will Doge finally break out of this range and start a new trend? Or are we about to see the same move from support to resistance play out once again?
